1.
Heard Mr. S. Nawaz, learned counsel for the petitioner.
Also heard Mr. R. R. Kaushik, learned Additional Public Prosecutor for the State of Assam.

2. This application under Section 482 of the BNSS, 2023 has been filed by the petitioners, namely, 1.
Pulin Karmakar, 2. Radhika Karmakar, 3. Anita Karmakar, 4. Pampa Dey @ Pampa Karmakar and 5. Lipei Ray @ Lipei Karmakar who are apprehending their arrest in connection with Lanka P.S.
Case No. 376/2024 under Sections 61(2)/ 329(3)/ 117(2)/ 324(4)/ 305/ 109 of the BNS, 2023.
3.

The gist of accusation in this case is that on 01.12.2024, the informant, Soma Dey Karmakar had lodged an FIR naming eight accused persons therein including the present petitioners, inter alia,
alleging them on Page No.# 3/5 01.12.2024, at about 2:00 PM, the FIR named accused persons entered into her house carrying a machete, stick, iron rod and other sharp weapon.

It is also alleged in the FIR that the accused persons physically assaulted the informant and her husband and the accused No. 3 named in the FIR, namely, Biplab Karmakar (not a petitioner in this case), is alleged to have attacked the informant with the iron rod on her head causing serious injuries on her person.

Against other accused persons, there are allegations of snatching away gold chain and trespassing to the house of the petitioner as well as causing mischief by breaking the mobile phone of the informant.
4. The learned counsel the petitioners has submitted that the allegations levelled in the FIR against the petitioners are false and nothing of that sort had ever happened.

He has submitted that the first informant and her husband (who is the son of the petitioner Nos. 1 and 2 and brother of petitioner Page No.# 1/5 vs The State Of Assam on 9 December, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/176246229/
2 Nos. 3, 4 and 5) are leaving separately from the petitioners after their marriage due to some disputes.

5. It is also submitted by the learned counsel for the petitioners that the false FIR has been lodged against the petitioners as the first informant and her husband were demanding the partition of the ancestral property of petitioner Nos. 1 and 2 which was not agreed to by them.
6. The learned counsel for the petitioners has also submitted that, the Police do not arrest the accused persons against whom allegations of offence under earlier Section 498A of IPC is alleged.
Hence, false accusation has been made against the petitioners in the FIR.
He also submits that the petitioners are ready to cooperate in the investigation.
Page No.# 4/5 7.

On the other hand, learned Additional Public Prosecutor has submitted that the main allegations which are non-bailable in nature are against the FIR named accused No. 3 for attacking the informant with an iron rod and against other petitioners for committing theft of gold chain of the informant.
He also submits that perusal of the case diary would be necessary for consideration of the instant bail application.

8. Call for the case diary.
9.
List this matter again on 07th of January, 2025.

10. However, considering the fact that the petitioners are the relatives of the first informant as well as considering the nature of allegations levelled with the FIR, all the above named petitioners are hereby directed to appear before the Investigating Officer of Lanka P.S. Case No. 376/2024 and cooperate in the investigation.

If they do so within the stipulated period of time, in the event of their arrest, in connection with aforesaid case, they shall be allowed to go on interim bail of Rs.30,000/-
(Rupees Thirty Thousand) each with one surety of like amount subject to satisfaction of the Arresting Authority with following conditions:-
(i) That the petitioners shall co-operate in the investigation;
(ii) That the petitioners shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to the informant or to any other persons who may be acquainted with the facts of the case so as to dissuade such person from disclosing such facts before the Investigating Officer or to any Court.
Page No.# 5/5 11.
List this matter again on 07th of January, 2025.
